rust_summary: a player's right click on a block with the hand that clicks, cancellable (`native_right_click_block_v2`).
doc_summary: `native_right_click_block_v2(pos, face, hand, cancel)`: `native_right_click_block` with the hand (`Hand::Main` or `Hand::Off`, NeoForge's `PlayerInteractEvent.RightClickBlock.getHand`), asked right after v1, once per hand tried; a click v1 canceled is not asked again. Bundles need "hooks": @API:right_click_block_v2@.
